name: University of Lucerne
summary: Public university in Lucerne; its bachelor's are taught in German, and you need a German C1 certificate by the time you start.

ib.text: 32/42 points, six subjects in the general curriculum, three at HL including maths or a science (2026/27 guidelines). German C1 certificate needed by the start of the programme, not with the application.

dates.label: Registration for the autumn semester opens (standing date)
Late applications close if you need no visa, CHF 150 surcharge (standing date)
Late applications close if you need a visa (standing date)

notes: Only some master's programmes are taught entirely in English; every bachelor's needs German.
The German certificate can follow your application, but you must have it by the start of the programme.
